result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but the bottom navigation has a clearly missing icon and some horizontal carousel content is awkwardly clipped at the right edge.

issues.description: The “Orders” item in the bottom navigation has no icon, leaving a conspicuous blank space above its label while every other navigation item has one.
issues.suggestion: Add the intended Orders icon and match the size, stroke weight, color, and vertical alignment of the other navigation icons.

issues.description: The category row ends with only a small unlabeled portion of the next pill visible, and the third restaurant card/text in “Fastest near you” is sharply clipped by the viewport edge.
issues.suggestion: Adjust carousel item widths, spacing, and right padding so partial next items provide a clear scroll cue without appearing accidentally cut off.
